summary: This code defines a Dagger object that runs Pylint (a Python code checker) on your source code. It creates a reusable pipeline component that takes a directory of Python files, spins up a container with Python installed, installs Pylint, and runs the linter to check for code quality issues.

explanations.2: This imports Annotated, which lets us attach extra metadata to function parameters to describe what they are.
explanations.4: The @object_type decorator tells Dagger that this class is a reusable component in a pipeline that can be called from other systems.
explanations.6: The @function decorator marks this method as a Dagger function that can be invoked as a pipeline step.
explanations.7: Annotated[Directory, DefaultPath("src")] means the source parameter expects a directory, but if none is provided, it defaults to looking for a folder named 'src'.
